name: Basil-Ricotta Polenta Bowl with Peach, Tomato, Arugula & Almond Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a large pot, bring broth to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1774 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups polenta (cornmeal)

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
6 peaches
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice each quarter and add to the bowl; stir to combine.
Roughly chop almonds and set aside.
When the polenta is almost done, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes and peaches (reserve the rest of the basil for the polenta).
Add arugula and almonds to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
When the polenta is done, add ricotta, salt, and pepper; whisk until smooth and creamy.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide polenta and salad between bowls; sprinkle reserved basil over the polenta. Enjoy!
